about: The Workbench icons of the Toppler drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/towertoppler.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/towertoppler.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Toppler-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Toppler.info beside the drawer; toppler.info is the program's. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-toppler, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
